source: FBR Circular No. 02 of 2026-27 · Finance Act 2026
headline: SALARIED?
CHECK YOUR PAYSLIP

items: **Rs 600,000 to 1.2 million:** **1%** of the amount above Rs 600,000
**Rs 1.2 to 2.2 million:** Rs 6,000 + **11%** of the amount above Rs 1.2 million
**Salaried above Rs 10 million:** the **9% surcharge** is withdrawn
